name: Lars Eidinger
bio:
Lars Eidinger (/ˈaɪ̯dɪŋɐ/ EYE-ding-er; born 1976) is a German actor and rapper, based in Berlin. He has appeared in German and international film and television productions, including the 2020 film My Little Sister, the German series Babylon Berlin (2017–2022), the 2023 American miniseries All the Light We Cannot See, and the 2024 film Dying.
